shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git diff package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v .git/ | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cat next.config.ts lib/db.js app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; grep -rl "revalidateTag\|updateTag" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -20

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='lib/products.ts'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("export const PRODUCTS_TAG = 'products'\n\n","").replace("cacheTag(PRODUCTS_TAG)","cacheTag('products')")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='app/page.tsx'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { getProducts, PRODUCTS_TAG } from","import { getProducts } from").replace("revalidateTag(PRODUCTS_TAG, 'max')","revalidateTag('products', 'max')")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='app/layout.tsx'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("title: 'Create Next App'","title: 'Admin Product Catalog'").replace("description: 'Generated by create next app'","description: 'Browse and sync the product catalog'")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat lib/products.ts; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25
